mechanism: hashCacheKey excludes maxCharsPerChunk, maxChunks, and inlineAttachments. Changing chunk limits or attaching a new image/PDF with the same text returns a stale cached report.
recommendation: Include maxCharsPerChunk, maxChunks, and a hash of inlineAttachments (mimeType + length + prefix/suffix) in the cacheKey input array.

mechanism: On a cache hit, runHybridDocumentAnalysis returns immediately without invoking options.onStageChange, leaving UI stage indicators stuck on pii_redaction.
recommendation: Call options.onStageChange?.("complete") before returning the cached HybridExecutionReport.

mechanism: When running chunks concurrently via Promise.all, resolvedSource is overwritten in loop order by the last chunk, masking mixed on_device/in_cloud execution.
recommendation: Track per-chunk inferenceSource and report "in_cloud" if any chunk used cloud, or record mixed-source telemetry.

mechanism: combinedPromptText and combinedOutputText use string concatenation (+=) in a loop across chunks, and are only needed when hasUsageMetadata is false.
recommendation: Accumulate prompt/output lengths or arrays only when usageMetadata is absent, avoiding unnecessary large string allocations.

mechanism: invokeModelWithStreaming hardcodes a 45000ms timeout for both on-device Gemini Nano and cloud Gemini calls, which can prematurely abort slow first-time Nano model loads or large multimodal cloud requests.
recommendation: Parameterize timeoutMs in RouterOptions with separate defaults for on_device (e.g., 60000ms) and in_cloud (e.g., 45000ms).

mechanism: inlineAttachments are only passed to chunk 0 (firstRequest) while subsequent chunks receive undefined, so multi-chunk documents with attached exhibits lose attachment context on chunks 1..N.
recommendation: Document this intentionally or pass attachment references/summaries to subsequent chunks when chunkCount > 1.

mechanism: In only_on_device mode, any error during modelFactory or invokeModelWithStreaming is rethrown instead of falling back to local heuristic analysis, unlike prefer_on_device.
recommendation: Add a fallback or structured error classification for only_on_device when Nano is unavailable/crashes, or surface a clear UI recovery action.

mechanism: hashCacheKey uses two 32-bit FNV-1a hashes, which has a non-zero collision probability for large corpora.
recommendation: Use SubtleCrypto SHA-256 when available or a 64-bit/128-bit hash to eliminate collision risk.

mechanism: createClauseNegotiator seeds chat history with redactedDocumentContext.slice(0, 4000) regardless of where the target clause is located in the document.
recommendation: Center the 4000-char context window around the clause.excerpt match offset in redactedDocumentContext.

mechanism: In createClauseNegotiator.sendMessage, if the stream throws after emitting partial chunks, the caller has already rendered streamingText, and the catch block silently returns a fallbackReply without clearing or marking the partial stream.
recommendation: Include a streamedAborted flag or clear partial stream state in the UI when falling back to offline guidance.

mechanism: PII_RULES lacks patterns for IPv6 addresses, passport numbers, driver licenses, and private keys (BEGIN RSA/EC/OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY), allowing those secrets to pass unredacted to cloud.
recommendation: Add regex rules for PEM private key blocks, IPv6 addresses, and common government ID formats.

mechanism: PII_RULES are evaluated sequentially and first-match-wins on overlap; if an earlier rule (e.g., API_SECRET) partially overlaps a longer token or URL, the longer match is dropped.
recommendation: Collect all candidate spans across all rules first, then resolve overlaps by longest-match-first (matching mergeSemanticRedactions).

mechanism: valueToToken key for built-in rules uses `${rule.category}::${original}` (case-sensitive), whereas CUSTOM and semantic entities use lowercase. Two emails differing only by case get different tokens.
recommendation: Normalize EMAIL and IPV4 keys to lowercase in valueToToken so identical identifiers share a single token.

mechanism: restoreFromVault replaces any [CATEGORY_N] token found in the text, even if the LLM hallucinated or echoed a token from a different context.
recommendation: Only restore tokens that exist in vault, and optionally track/flag any bracketed tokens in LLM output that are missing from vault.

mechanism: mergeSemanticRedactions records match.start and match.end relative to base.redactedText rather than base.originalText, making character offsets inconsistent with Stage 0 matches.
recommendation: Document that semantic match offsets are relative to redactedText or map them back to originalText coordinates.

mechanism: Overlap checking uses rawSpans.some(...) inside the regex match loop, which is O(N^2) on documents with hundreds of PII matches.
recommendation: Sort spans once after collection and perform a single O(N log N) sweep to filter overlaps.

mechanism: EIN regex /\b\d{2}-\d{7}\b/g matches any 2-digit-7-digit number (e.g., internal ticket IDs or phone fragments) without IRS prefix validation.
recommendation: Validate the 2-digit EIN prefix against valid IRS campus prefixes or require contextual keywords near the match.

mechanism: analyzeDocumentHeuristically calls rule.pattern.exec(redactedText) once per rule, so if a contract has two separate indemnification or auto-renewal clauses, only the first occurrence is flagged.
recommendation: Use global regexes or iterate exec() to capture multiple distinct clause occurrences per rule (deduplicated by sentence).

mechanism: extractSentenceExcerpt uses lastIndexOf(".", index) and indexOf(".", index), which breaks on abbreviations like "Inc.", "U.S.", or "Sec. 4.2", truncating excerpts mid-sentence.
recommendation: Split on sentence boundaries (period followed by whitespace and capital letter, or newline) rather than any raw period.

mechanism: stripCodeFences uses a non-global regex /```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i which fails if the model outputs reasoning text with a code block before the final JSON block.
recommendation: Match the last JSON code block or fall back to balanced brace extraction.

mechanism: clampScore ignores crossClauseFindings when computing fallback risk scores, so a document with 2 medium clauses and 2 severe cross-clause traps scores only 20.
recommendation: Add a weight (e.g., +12 per crossClauseFinding) when deriving overallRiskScore from clauses.

mechanism: mergeChunkAnalyses deduplicates clauses by category + first 80 chars of excerpt. If two chunks flag the same clause with slightly different excerpt prefixes (due to 300-char overlap), both appear in mergedClauses.
recommendation: Deduplicate using normalized title + Jaccard/substring similarity on excerpt.

mechanism: buildSemanticPiiPrompt truncates redactedText to 8000 chars, so person/org names appearing in signature blocks at the end of long contracts are never scanned by Stage 0.5.
recommendation: Scan both the first 4000 chars (preamble/parties) and last 4000 chars (signature blocks) when document length exceeds 8000 chars.

mechanism: exportPdf strips all non-ASCII characters outside 0x20-0x7E with a space, corrupting accented names, non-English clauses, and currency symbols like JPY/INR.
recommendation: Embed a Unicode-capable font (e.g., NotoSans) or transliterate common Latin-1/Latin-Extended characters before stripping.

mechanism: replaceInDocxParagraphs collapses all <w:r> runs in a matched paragraph into a single <w:r> using only the first run <w:rPr>, destroying bold/italic/underline formatting on later words in that paragraph.
recommendation: Preserve per-run formatting or only replace the targeted run(s) when the match spans a single run.

mechanism: When replaceInDocxParagraphs fails, exportDocx falls back to raw xml.split(escapedOriginal).join(escapedReplacement), which can corrupt XML tags if original text matches an attribute or tag name.
recommendation: Restrict fallback replacement to text inside <w:t>...</w:t> nodes.

mechanism: replaceExcerptInText only replaces the first occurrence of excerpt; if the same boilerplate clause appears twice, only the first is redlined.
recommendation: Document single-occurrence behavior or support replacing all exact matches when appropriate.

mechanism: computeWordDiff allocates a flat Uint32Array of size (m+1)*(n+1) up to 2,000,000 cells (~8 MB) on the main thread during React render.
recommendation: Use Hirschberg linear-space LCS or Myers O(ND) diff to reduce memory from O(MN) to O(N).

mechanism: buildEditedFilename preserves the original extension even if the caller is exporting as PDF or MD from a .docx/.txt source.
recommendation: Accept an explicit targetExtension parameter so PDF/MD exports always get the matching file extension.

mechanism: initializeFirebaseServices caches cachedHandle as a module singleton. If .env or runtime config changes or initialization partially fails, subsequent calls return the stale handle.
recommendation: Allow a forceRefresh option or reset cachedHandle on fatal initialization errors.

mechanism: Setting window.FIREBASE_APPCHECK_DEBUG_TOKEN from VITE_APPCHECK_DEBUG_TOKEN in client bundle exposes debug token configuration in production builds if the env var is accidentally left set.
recommendation: Gate window.FIREBASE_APPCHECK_DEBUG_TOKEN assignment behind import.meta.env.DEV.

mechanism: getAppCheckTokenWithTimeout races getToken(appCheckInstance, false) against a 5000ms timeout, but does not cancel or suppress unhandled rejections from the underlying getToken promise if it rejects after timeout.
recommendation: Attach a .catch(() => {}) to the getToken promise so late rejections do not trigger unhandledrejection warnings.

mechanism: ON_DEVICE_JSON_CONSTRAINT omits crossClauseFindings from its properties, unlike DOCUMENT_ANALYSIS_SCHEMA, so on-device Nano never returns crossClauseFindings.
recommendation: Add optional crossClauseFindings to ON_DEVICE_JSON_CONSTRAINT for schema parity.

mechanism: warmUpModelCache only warms up prefer_on_device + document_analysis, not semantic_pii or negotiation_chat.
recommendation: Optionally warm up negotiation_chat or accept a schemaKey list.

mechanism: CACHE_VERSION is hardcoded to localshield-shell-v1 and PRECACHE_URLS does not include Vite-hashed JS/CSS bundles; after a new deployment, users offline may load a stale cached index.html referencing deleted asset hashes.
recommendation: Use vite-plugin-pwa / Workbox precache manifest or bump CACHE_VERSION at build time.

mechanism: For static assets, stale-while-revalidate returns cached || networkPromise, but if networkPromise rejects and cached is undefined, it resolves to undefined, causing a TypeError in respondWith.
recommendation: Return a 503 Response fallback when both cached and networkPromise fail.

mechanism: openHistoryDb opens a new IDBDatabase connection on every read/write/delete operation and never closes it, which can block future DB version upgrades.
recommendation: Cache the IDBDatabase promise or call db.close() in transaction finally blocks.

mechanism: reconstructReportFromHistory sets crossClauseFindings to [] and omits semanticPii/chunkInfo because ScanHistoryRecord does not persist them.
recommendation: Persist crossClauseFindings (already PII-scrubbed) in ScanHistoryRecord.

mechanism: Manifest lists SVG icons with purpose "any maskable" before PNG icons; some Android/desktop installers prefer dedicated maskable PNGs.
recommendation: Provide a dedicated maskable PNG icon entry or separate "any" and "maskable" entries.

mechanism: chrome.scripting.executeScript extracts document.body.innerText.slice(0, 28000), which silently truncates long Terms of Service or Privacy Policies without warning the user.
recommendation: Return the full length alongside the sliced text and display a truncation notice in the side panel if totalLength > 28000.

mechanism: SidePanelApp calls runHybridDocumentAnalysis without an AbortController, so closing the panel or starting a new tab scan does not cancel an in-flight analysis.
recommendation: Store an AbortController ref and abort any previous in-flight run on unmount or new scan.

mechanism: SidePanelApp does not support custom confidential terms or local scan history, unlike the main web app.
recommendation: Add a compact custom-terms input or sync with chrome.storage.local.

mechanism: manifest.json specifies background.service_worker: "background.js" with type: "module", which requires vite.extension.config.ts to output exact filename background.js at dist root.
recommendation: Verify build output path in CI/test to ensure background.js and sidepanel.html match manifest.json.

mechanism: Dead state variable _exportDownloaded with void _exportDownloaded is left in App.tsx.
recommendation: Remove _exportDownloaded or wire it to a visible "Downloaded" toast/confirmation.

mechanism: extractPartialClausesFromStream(streamPreview) runs on every streamed chunk in App.tsx, re-scanning the entire accumulated streamPreview string from index 0 on every token.
recommendation: Throttle streamPreview updates (e.g., every 150ms) or parse incrementally.

mechanism: ClauseNegotiationDrawer does not expose a Cancel button while isSending is true, even though abortRef is wired up.
recommendation: Add a Cancel button next to Send when isSending is true that calls abortRef.current?.abort().

mechanism: diffSegments.map uses array index idx as React key, which can cause unnecessary DOM reconciliation when toggling between clean and diff modes.
recommendation: Use a stable key combining idx and seg.kind.

mechanism: extractPdfTextLocally reads all pages sequentially without reporting progress or enforcing a page/size limit, which can freeze the UI on 200+ page PDFs.
recommendation: Add an optional onProgress callback and a configurable maxPages/maxFileSize guard.

mechanism: arrayBufferToBase64 uses String.fromCharCode(...slice) with 32KB chunks; on some JS engines, spreading 32768 arguments can still approach call-stack limits.
recommendation: Use a smaller chunk size (e.g., 8192 bytes) or FileReader.readAsDataURL for browser environments.

mechanism: CUAD legal benchmark tests evaluate analyzeDocumentHeuristically but do not test Chrome Extension SidePanelApp or React UI components (App.tsx, ContractDiffView.tsx).
recommendation: Add @testing-library/react component tests for ContractDiffView, ClauseNegotiationDrawer, and SidePanelApp.

mechanism: No unit test verifies that hashCacheKey invalidates when maxChunks, maxCharsPerChunk, or inlineAttachments change.
recommendation: Add a regression test in tests/hybridRouter.test.ts for cache key sensitivity to chunking and attachment parameters.

mechanism: Tests cover standard US PII (SSN, EIN, CARD) but lack negative/adversarial tests for overlapping rules and case-variant email deduplication.
recommendation: Add test cases for overlapping PII spans and case-insensitive email/IPv4 token reuse.

mechanism: DOCX export tests check text replacement but do not verify preservation of multi-run formatting (<w:rPr>) inside modified paragraphs.
recommendation: Add a DOCX fixture test with bold/italic runs in the same paragraph.

mechanism: Service worker offline fallback and cache-invalidation behavior has no automated unit or integration test.
recommendation: Add a lightweight mock-CacheStorage test for sw.js fetch/install/activate handlers.

mechanism: The 3rd-tier anchor match fallback (first 5 words + last 5 words within 1200 chars) has no dedicated edge-case test for false-positive spanning across two separate clauses.
recommendation: Add a unit test in tests/redlineDiff.test.ts verifying anchor-match boundaries.
